name: com.mytoolz.uilayoutsystem
description: WORK IN PROGRESS. Reusable UI elements only for now: UIStrongButton (a Button that surfaces broken/empty onClick bindings and queues the click behind its UITweener animation), FlexLayoutGroup, and SafeAreaFitter. The full UI layout authoring/orchestration system (baking, templates, layout service) is still in development and is intentionally not included in this package yet. Requires DOTween and UniTask.
